disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an 'inconclusive' verdict because it encountered an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to audit the .SRCINFO file. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly determined the package is safe. The openrouter model (advisory) also found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict.
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) during the audit of non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if the primary executable files (PKGBUILD) are successfully audited and deemed safe.
Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for API failures on specific files to prevent a single file's audit failure from blocking the entire package verdict.
